def factor_range_pressure_conditional_vol_asymmetry(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    # primary mechanism: cycle range pressure over 60 days
    buy_pressure = (close - df_copy["low"]).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    sell_pressure = (df_copy["high"] - close).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    total_range = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    range_pressure = (buy_pressure - sell_pressure) / total_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    # lightweight modifier: downside volume participation, attenuated only when extreme
    ret = close.pct_change()
    down_vol = volume.where(ret < 0, 0.0).rolling(60, min_periods=30).sum()
    total_vol = volume.rolling(60, min_periods=30).sum().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    down_ratio = down_vol / total_vol
    # dynamic threshold: 20% above trailing median down_ratio triggers mild attenuation
    median_down_ratio = down_ratio.rolling(60, min_periods=20).median()
    attenuate = (down_ratio > median_down_ratio * 1.2).astype(float)
    scale = 1.0 - 0.3 * attenuate
    factor = range_pressure * scale
    df_copy["factor_range_pressure_conditional_vol_asymmetry"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_range_pressure_conditional_vol_asymmetry"]
description: Preserves the parent crossover's primary cycle range-pressure mechanism from market_cycle_0002, which identifies accumulation/distribution phase by the position of closes within the trailing 60-day high-low range. The parent used a continuous multiplicative attenuation by down_ratio, which can over-attenuate the signal even during normal volume regimes, potentially weakening IC/ICIR. This mutation changes the lightweight downside-volume modifier to a conditional gate: only when downside volume participation is more than 20% above its own trailing median does the range-pressure signal get mildly scaled by 0.7. This preserves the raw range-pressure strength most of the time, targeting improved IC and ICIR while retaining the RankIC/RankICIR and payoff strengths from both parent candidates. Keeps exactly one core mechanism and one lightweight modifier, and retains cross_sectional_transform none to preserve raw payoff structure.
